newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian weekly inflation unchanged at 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian weekly inflation unchanged at 0.3 pct.

text.p: Russian inflation was unchanged at 0.3 percent in the week ended June 23 from the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of June will be 1.1 percent, the committee said. Half year inflation will be 8.6 percent, it said.
The monthly inflation rate in May was 0.9 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended June 23 June 16
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.5 +0.6
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.042 +0.076
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
